hardware: Jetson AGX Thor sm_110a, 117GB unified LPDDR5X

cutlass.notes: VLLM_CUTLASS. Processes all 256 experts cleanly (70.46 GiB model load, no crash). The ONLY working NVFP4 MoE backend for this 256-expert model on Thor.

marlin.notes: Silent EngineCore death (exit 255, no traceback, not OOM) at the FP4 MoE weight-repack (nvfp4.py:491 'Using MoEPrepareAndFinalizeNoDPEPModular'). _moe_C.abi3.so HAS sm_110a and MoE dims are 128-aligned, so it is a genuine in-kernel fault at 256-expert scale, matching vLLM issues #35566/#35519/#35922. Works fine for smaller-expert-count models (35B).

triton.notes: ValueError: moe_backend='triton' is not supported for NvFP4 MoE. Not an option for any NVFP4 model.

flashinfer_cutlass.notes: flashinfer fused_moe .so compiled for sm_100a/sm_103a only, no sm_110a. VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_MOE_FP4 must be 0 on Thor.

flashinfer_trtllm.notes: trtllm gemm .so is sm_100a only. Unsupported on Thor sm_110.

emulation.notes: Pure-fallback path; functional but slow. Not needed since cutlass works.

attention_backend_note: cutlass MoE + flashinfer attention dies in warmup with 'BatchDecodeWithPagedKVCacheWrapper.run() got an unexpected keyword argument kv_cache_sf' (flashinfer API mismatch in the dflash fork). TRITON_ATTN avoids it.
